Title: Chef Tycoon
Description:
Chef Tycoon, a free chef game online where you manage your own restaurant, prepare delicious dishes, and serve customers under time pressure. This cooking tycoon experience blends fast-paced food preparation with smart business upgrades, turning every shift into a rewarding management challenge.

Start with a small setup, serve efficiently, earn profits, and grow your culinary empire step by step. As your restaurant expands, smarter decisions and better workflow management become the key to long-term success.
Instructions:
Take control of your chef and prepare customer orders.
Serve dishes quickly to maintain satisfaction levels.
Complete level goals to unlock new recipes and improvements.
Earn coins to upgrade your kitchen and expand operations.
Each stage increases the pace, requiring sharper time management.

Desktop Controls:
↑ (Up Arrow): Move upward.
↓ (Down Arrow): Move downward.
← (Left Arrow): Move left.
→ (Right Arrow): Move right.

On-Screen Joystick: Move in all directions by dragging the joystick.

Title: Idle Hotel Empire Tycoon
Description: Step into the role of a manager for a small Hotel. Open and upgrade rooms, restaurants, leisure areas, and various cafes. Embellish the exterior and interior of your Hotel to attract more visitors! Hire staff to service the rooms and open parking lots. Invest your profits back into your business and multiply your earnings! The core genre is Idle Tycoon. You'll need to continuously develop your business - a small Hotel - over an extended period. Open all rooms and leisure facilities (halls, cafes, parks) to increase your profits from each visitor. You can speed up service time by tapping on the progress bar located above each cashier's desk and at the reception. Additionally, you can watch short videos to receive temporary and instant bonuses to your earnings!
Instructions:
Access to all main game mechanics is available from the main screen.
Use the left mouse button to interact with the in-game UI.

Title: Idle Magic Academy Tycoon
Description:
Idle Magic Academy Tycoon is a charming management simulator that puts you in charge of a growing academy of sorcery. You design classrooms, recruit skilled Magisters, and gather powerful artifacts to shape each lesson. As headmaster, you guide students from simple theories to advanced combat spells, expanding your academy into a legendary center of magic.

Manage your academy wisely, constantly improve the quality of education, and transform your institution into a legendary center of arcane mastery! Develop your Academy’s infrastructure, collect Arcanum Spheres, and research magical technologies. Build your own center of magical education — step by step, classroom by classroom, artifact by artifact
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do players do?
A: This is an idle tycoon game set in a magical academy. You build and upgrade various facilities, train students, and generate profits.

Q: What is the game's hook? What makes it stand out to players?
A: The game features a polished, beautiful design along with various features like daily quests, tasks, and achievements to keep players engaged.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work? What can be done to level up faster?
A: Success requires strategic thinking to upgrade the right functions and academy facilities. This increases your profit, which can then be reinvested into further upgrades.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: Gold coins are used for upgrading academy facilities and expanding features, such as adding more student slots, increasing training speed, and improving the quality of education. Diamonds can also be purchased to speed up construction.

Q: Are there in-app purchases? What can players buy, and how do they affect gameplay?
A: Yes, players can purchase diamonds and an option to remove ads to speed up their progress.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar mechanics to encourage player return?
A: There are daily rewards as well as free hourly chests that contain mages or in-game currency.

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for immersion, or will players face difficulties without it?
A: The sound design is high-quality, but it is not required to progress in the game.
Instructions:
The introductory tutorial will familiarize you with the core game mechanics, including purchasing and upgrading rooms.

To buy or upgrade a room, click on the area where the room is located. In the window that opens, you will see information about the cost as well as a purchase button. If the room has already been purchased, a management window will appear with various content options depending on the room type. To upgrade the content of the selected room, choose the desired item and click the “Upgrade” button.

Access to all main game mechanics is available from the main screen.

Title: Merge Plane Tycoon

Merge Plane Tycoon is a fun and addictive tycoon game where you build your own air empire by merging planes and upgrading them into powerful aircraft ✈️⚡

Start with small planes, merge identical ones, and unlock faster, stronger, and more advanced jets 🚀 Each upgrade boosts your income and expands your airline business 💰

Manage your runway, discover new plane types, and watch your fleet grow automatically even while you’re offline ⏳

Simple controls, satisfying merge mechanics, and colorful visuals make Merge Plane Tycoon perfect for casual and idle gameplay 🎮

How far can you grow your air empire and dominate the skies? ☁️👑

Drag a plane and drop it onto another plane of the same type using your mouse or touch controls. When they match, the planes merge into a stronger one with higher value and performance. 
Keep merging, unlocking new planes, and expanding your runway to earn more money and grow your air empire

Title: Rotcalypse Idle
Description:
Rotcalypse is a satirical idle tycoon where you monetize digital decay. Transform questionable content into pure profit, scaling from primitive RotToks to a global Brainrot VR-machine.
No thinking required—only expansion. Your goal is the total degradation of the internet for the sake of infinite numbers. Experience a dark reflection of social media addiction, perfect for "killing" time.
Instructions:
How to Play
Click to Launch: Manually trigger production cycles to generate your initial capital and kickstart the economy.
Invest & Upgrade: Spend earnings on Business Upgrades and Skill Improvements to increase the efficiency of every action.
Expand Ventures: Purchase and unlock new Business Branches to diversify your portfolio and raise your profit ceiling.
Automate Growth: Hire Managers to automate cycles, transforming manual clicks into a high-speed passive income stream.

Prestige Reset: Perform a Reset to sacrifice current progress in exchange for permanent Prestige Multipliers, allowing you to reach significantly higher milestones in the next run.

Title: Maskinery Idle
Description: Maskinery Idle is an incremental clicker game where you explore mysterious islands, fight enemies, and collect powerful masks that grant unique abilities. Clear all tiles on each location's grid to progress through 5 stages. Defeat the Boss on the final stage to complete the zone and unlock the next one. Collect gold to buy upgrades, earn energy to level up your masks, and use the Rebirth system
Instructions:
Controls

Left click / Tap -> Attack a tile, activate a mask, press a button
That's it — the entire game is played with a single click/tap. No keyboard required.

Gameplay

1. Click tiles to deal damage equal to your Power stat. Destroyed tiles drop Gold and Energy.
2. Enemies (red tiles) fight back — they reflect damage to you. If your HP is too low to survive a hit, the enemy becomes locked until you heal.
3. Boss appears on stage 5 as a large 3x3 tile. Clear the tiles covering it first, then defeat it to complete the location.
4. Return to the Village (safe zone) to spend gold on upgrades: Max HP, HP Regen, and Power.
